description: Defines the TenantAdminPermissions class which manages permission checks for various resources within the tenant administration context in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TenantAdminPermissions
classes.description: Manages permissions for tenant admin resources, defining various permission checkers for resource access control.

methods.name: tenantEntityPermissionChecker
methods.description: Permission checker allowing all operations or verifying tenant ownership for entities.

methods.name: tenantPermissionChecker
methods.description: Permission checker for tenant-level permissions with specific allowed operations.

methods.name: userPermissionChecker
methods.description: Permission checker for user entities, restricting SYS_ADMIN authority and tenant ownership.

methods.name: widgetsPermissionChecker
methods.description: Permission checker for widget-related resources, verifying tenant ownership or read operation.

methods.name: tbResourcePermissionChecker
methods.description: Permission checker for TB resources, verifying tenant ownership or read operation.

methods.name: queuePermissionChecker
methods.description: Permission checker for queues, verifying tenant ownership or read operation.

methods.name: aiModelPermissionChecker
methods.description: Permission checker for AI models, verifying tenant ownership.

methods.name: apiKeysPermissionChecker
methods.description: Permission checker for API keys, verifying tenant ownership.
